mechanism: Establish one stable subject as a quiet center inside a visibly active environment. Let the subject perform one deliberate self-sealing gesture, keep external motion escalating while the subject becomes still, then use one full-frame perceptual wash to replace the environment. Restore the same identity and optical axis in a materially different location and require one visible resumption action that proves the new space persists.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable subject against independently moving surroundings before the trigger.
invariants.ablation_failure: A quiet or empty opening provides no pressure to isolate from.

invariants.rule: Use one deliberate bilateral or otherwise complete self-sealing gesture without changing location yet.
invariants.purpose: Makes the transition voluntary and countable.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained flash removes causal ownership.

invariants.rule: Continue environmental motion while the sealed subject reaches a visibly still state.
invariants.purpose: Builds separation before the decisive swap.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping everything together erases the subject-environment contrast.

invariants.rule: Replace the whole environment only once through a bounded full-frame perceptual wash while preserving the subject axis.
invariants.purpose: Makes the swap decisive without a montage of portals.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple partial swaps or a new camera axis break continuity.

invariants.rule: Restore the same identity in a materially different location and show one resumption action under the new physics.
invariants.purpose: Proves that the destination persists after the transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending in white light or on a static portrait leaves the spatial change unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source platinum-haired woman in white shirt and black tie
the source crowded urban zebra crossing and green rice field
the source exact city-whiteout-field order and arm-spread ending

instantiations.concept: In an original deep-sea service bay, a compact ceramic diver stands centered while maintenance drones streak around the dock. The diver closes a transparent pressure visor with both hands, surrounding motion continues as the body becomes still, a single bioluminescent wash fills the frame, and the same diver reappears on a quiet kelp nursery floor to release one tethered seed pod into the current.

instantiations.concept: In a paper observatory, a felt astronomer remains fixed while star charts and assistants slide around a circular worktable. The astronomer folds two hinged eye shields into place, the charts continue moving, one white paper eclipse replaces the room, and the same figure resumes by raising a brass wind vane on a snowy rooftop garden.
